name: write_document
title: Create or edit a project document
description: Create a document (title and content, no slug) or edit one (slug, base_version, new content and/or title). Every write needs message: a one-line reason. Content replaces the whole text: read first. Stale base_version is refused. No delete. No secrets. Answer: doc: link, section anchors.

slug.description: The document to edit; none: create.

content.description: The whole markdown; required to create.

base_version.description: The version you read; required to edit.

message.description: Required: one line saying why you change the document; it shows in the history beside you.

annotations.title: Create or edit a project document
